system.description: • Effect: Apex Predator applies every time you use Marked Prey, with no daily limit. You have Advantage on every attack roll against your marked prey, not only the first each round, and on checks to track, corner or finish it.

rules.value: Peerless Hunter: Advantage on every attack roll against your marked prey; Apex Predator applies every time you use Marked Prey, with no daily limit.
